Define an agent-run evidence schema that binds Task Packet, starting snapshot, candidate identity/configuration, trajectory references, wall time, observed usage (or unavailable), changed files, validation evidence, and Outcome Packet.

Define a contamination protocol because the strongest historical candidates and their solutions are already present in Git history/current main.
Decide which measurements are mandatory and which may be unavailable; existing scorecard explicitly forbids inventing Codex telemetry.
Select only privacy-safe, offline-replayable cases; do not incorporate the private phone-photo corpus.

limitations: This was an artifact/source/history archaeology pass; no providers, contestants, tests, or bake-off runs were executed.
The local worktree inventory was factual only. Worktree content was not broadly read, and untracked/ignored namespaces were not enumerated.
Protected/private coin inputs and ignored phone-photo evidence were intentionally excluded, so their detailed suitability is unverified.
No network fetch was performed; local refs and retained Git history are the only historical source used.
Exact session-wide context accounting is unavailable in this environment; this pass remained below the repository's 50K warning threshold by operational estimate.
